findings.issue: In this copy of _addLeaf the loop variable is printed as an offset from its initial value (s = node - leaf), so each iteration adds the 250-character leaf hash and subtracts it again, and the final store adds it once more; the three other inlined copies print the clean recurrence s = sha3(stor[t + 51], s). Exact, but the Merkle update is unrecognisable.
findings.rule: Express a loop-carried value as 'initial + offset' only when every update adds a loop-invariant amount; for any other update (here a hash of the variable) keep the variable itself, initialised to the leaf.
